name: Trumpeter's Service
summary: Milk jug and lid with decoration depicting Middle Eastern musicians, this design is known as the 'Trumpeter's Service' and shows 18th century interest in the "mysterious East", may possibly have been by the Dutch designer Cornelis Pronk (1691-1759); porcelain painted in overglaze enamels and gilt; C
